ok.label: all green
ok.hint: JetStream healthy (some offline PCs are normal)

degraded.label: degraded
degraded.hint: JetStream resource missing or all agents offline — attention needed

recentResults.title: Recent job results
recentResults.descriptionAllGreen: Results of jobs run on each PC · last {{count}} all green
recentResults.descriptionFailed: Results of jobs run on each PC · {{failed}} of last {{count}} failed
recentResults.descriptionFailedSkipped: Results of jobs run on each PC · {{failed}} of last {{count}} failed, {{skipped}} skipped
recentResults.descriptionSkipped: Results of jobs run on each PC · last {{count}}: no failures, {{skipped}} skipped (not run)

recentActivity.title: Recent activity
recentActivity.rowTitle: Open the related runs / audit log

upcoming.title: Upcoming schedules
upcoming.description: Soonest fires across enabled calendar schedules

versions.title: Version distribution
versions.description: Agent count per version (bar = count, right = active/total). A quick read on rollout coverage.

scanDuration.title: Scan duration (last 24 h, slowest first)
scanDuration.description: Per-job execution time from execution_results.{started,finished}_at. Use to spot a probe that's gotten unexpectedly slow without checking individual rows.
scanDuration.empty: No finished executions in the last 24 h.
scanDuration.linkTitle: View this job's runs in Activity
scanDuration.maxLinkTitle: Open the slowest run's detail page

fleetPerf.title: Fleet performance (last 24 h)
fleetPerf.description: Average across every reporting PC, bucketed 15 min. Source: /api/perf/fleet.
fleetPerf.empty: No host-perf samples yet — agents publish on a 60 s cadence.

topCpu.title: Top CPU (last 5 min)
topCpu.description: PCs ranked by average CPU% over the recent window. Click pc_id for the per-host charts.

topMem.title: Top memory (last 5 min)
topMem.description: PCs ranked by average memory used over the recent window.

activeInvestigations.title: Process-detail investigations
activeInvestigations.description: PCs that have published a process_perf sample in the last 5 min. Clear stragglers with the Disable now button on each agent's detail page.
activeInvestigations.empty: No PCs in investigation mode right now.

degraded.description: These queries are failing - the numbers below may be stale or incomplete, not a quiet fleet.

natsAuth.grace: Broker authentication mode was changed recently: new findings are held back until {{until}} while connections re-establish.
natsAuth.blind: The authentication audit is not reading the broker right now ({{status}}); an empty list is not a clean result.

broker_open.title: The NATS broker is not authenticating connections
broker_open.description: At least one connection got in without any credential. Anyone who can reach the broker can connect.

token_reverted.title: Connections are using the shared token although users mode is expected
token_reverted.description: The switch to per-role users did not take effect or was reverted on the broker.

role_user_mismatch.title: Connections authenticated as another role's user
role_user_mismatch.description: The user the broker authenticated does not belong to the role the connection announces. Check for a misconfigured host or credential misuse.

credential_unnameable.title: Some connection credentials could not be identified
credential_unnameable.description: The broker did not report a nameable credential for these connections, so they could not be judged.
